entries.german:
Abt Heinrich und der Konvent von St. Gallen verkaufen dem Johanniterhaus Rheinfelden das Eigentumsrecht an bisher zu Erblehen besessenen Gütern in Warmbach mit dem Patronatsrecht.

In a) nomine domini amen. Omnibus presentem litteram inspecturis Hainricus b) dei gratia abbas monasterii saneti Galli 1 .. c) totusque conventus eiusdem monasterii Const(antiensis) || diocesis d) I salutem in domino cum notitia subscriptorum. Noverint universi, quos nosce fuerit oportunum, quod nos habitis traetatu et deliberatione e) inter nos diligentia de || alienatione aliquarum possessionum minus utilium | no-stri monasterii propter onera debitorum dicti monasterii, a quibus absque aliquali alienatione excuti non poteramus, urigentibus g) usuris || gravibus et obsidibus deliberavimus unanimiter requisito consensu omnium, | qui debent et consuerunt h) super alienationibus i) requiri, bona nostra in Warmbach 2 minus utilia et k) longe a l) nostro monasterio posita alienare, et l) quequidem bona dilecti in Christo . . conmendator et . . fratres domus hospitalis saneti Johannis Jerosolimitani m) prope Rinvelden 3 Basiliensis dyocesis in emphiteosim n) perpetuam ab antiquo a nostro o) monasterio tenuerunt pro annuo censu decem lib ramm cere tantum 4, et ideirco curiam nostram cum omnibus bonis nostris in willa p) et banno Warmbach sitis cum omnibus pertinentiis suis cum debita sollempnitate vendidimus, cessimus q) et tradidimus cum omnibus iuribus tam corporalibus quam incorporalibus et l) quoad dominium directum, quod nobis tantum in eisdem competebat, et cum iurepatronatus ecclesie ibidem supradictis .. conmendatori et . . c) fratribus pro precio triginta marcarum argenti legalis ponderis Constantiensis, quas confitemur nos recepisse et in utilitatem nostri monasterii versas fuisse, ad habendum, tenendum et in perpetuum possidendum et quidquid de eisdem placuerit ipsis faciendum, absolvendo ipsos taliter r) a censu memorato, obligantes insuper nos nostrosque successores, qui pro tempore fuerint, ad plenam warandiam et ad quodlibet evictionis periculum subeundos coram quocumque iudice ecclesiastico vel civili cum sollempnitate debita ac refusione expensarum, dampnorum et interesse .. conmendatori et .. fratribus antedictis ac successoribus eorundem, adhibitis in omnibus supradictis quibuslibet verborum et gestuum sollempnitatibus debitis et consuetis. Ceterum ut omnia supradieta inviolabiliter observentur, promittimus pro nobis et nostris successoribus omnia et singula supradicta rata et firma tenere et non contrafacere vel facientibus consentire sub pena dupli nomine interesse apposita, renuntiantes nichilominus pro nobis nostrisque successoribus s), qui pro tempore fuerint, exceptionibus doli mali, non numerate pecunie t),non solute, deceptionis ultra dimidiam iusti precii, beneficio restitutionis in integrum principaliter et incidenter postulando, statutis u) iuribus tam editis quam edendis, litteris, privilegiis et indulgentiis a sede apostolica seu aliunde v) inpetratis seu etiam inpetrandis et generaliter w) omni suffragio et beneficio iuris vel facti, quibus contra x) premissa y) nos vel nostri successores venire possemus vel aliquod premissorum z). In cuius rei testimonium et robur perpetuum presentes litteras predictis aa) .. conmendatori et .. fratribus cum sigillis nostri ab) .. abbatis predicti ac) et conventus ad) tradidimus sigillatas. Datum et actum apud sanctum Gallum, anno domini millesimo ae) CCC°. quarto, die af) sabbati ante festum nativitatis beate virginis proxima, presentibus Růd. ag) de Roschach 5, Eglolfo ah) de Rosenberg 6, Berngero et Hug. ai) de Landenberg ak)7 et Eberh. aI) de Bichelnse 8 militibus, magistro Johanne dicto Pfefferhart canonico ecclesie Curiensis 9 et quampluribus aliis fide dignis. am) Facta itaque copia prem[issorum, nos] an) .. conmendator predictus in evidentiam eorundem sigillum nostrum duximus presentibus appendendum. Datum anno et die supradictis, ind. II a. >

entries.english:
Abbot Heinrich and the convent of St. Gallen sell to the Hospitaller house of Rheinfelden ownership of properties at Warmbach, previously held as hereditary fiefs, together with the right of patronage.

In the name of the Lord, amen. Heinrich, by God's grace abbot of the monastery of St. Gallen, and the entire convent of that monastery in the diocese of Constance wish salvation in the Lord and knowledge of the following to all who inspect this letter. Let all who need to know understand that, after careful discussion and deliberation among ourselves concerning the alienation of certain properties of little use to our monastery, because of the burdens of its debts, from which we could not free ourselves without some alienation, and under pressure from heavy interest and sureties, we unanimously resolved, with the required consent of all whose consent is required in such alienations, to alienate our less useful properties at Warmbach, far from our monastery. The beloved in Christ, the commander and brothers of the Hospital of St. John of Jerusalem near Rheinfelden in the diocese of Basel, have from ancient times held these properties from our monastery in perpetual emphyteusis for an annual rent of only ten pounds of wax. Accordingly, with due solemnity we have sold, ceded, and conveyed our farm with all our properties in the village and district of Warmbach, with all its appurtenances, all corporeal and incorporeal rights, and the direct lordship that alone belonged to us therein, together with the right of patronage of the church there, to the aforementioned commander and brothers for thirty marks of silver of lawful Constance weight, which we acknowledge having received and applied to the use of our monastery. They may hold and possess it forever and do with it whatever they wish, and we release them from the said rent. We further bind ourselves and our successors to full warranty and to answer any claim of eviction before any ecclesiastical or civil judge, with due formalities and reimbursement of expenses, damages, and interest to the aforementioned commander and brothers and their successors. To ensure all the foregoing is observed inviolably, we promise on behalf of ourselves and our successors to hold all of it valid and firm and neither to act against it nor consent to anyone doing so, under a stipulated penalty of double the amount as damages. We renounce for ourselves and our successors the defenses of fraud, money not counted or not paid, a transaction for less than half the just price, restitution in integrum as principal or incidental relief, existing or future statutes and laws, letters, privileges, and indulgences obtained or to be obtained from the Apostolic See or elsewhere, and generally every legal or factual aid by which we or our successors might oppose the foregoing or any part of it. In witness and permanent confirmation, we have delivered these letters, sealed with the seals of the aforementioned abbot and convent, to the commander and brothers. Given and enacted at St. Gallen in the year 1304, on the Saturday immediately before the feast of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin, in the presence of Rudolf von Rorschach, Ritter; Egilolf von Rosenberg, Ritter; Bernger and Hugo von Landenberg, Ritter; and Eberhard von Bichelsee, Ritter, Magister Johannes called Pfefferhart, canon of the church of Chur, and many other trustworthy people. After a copy of the foregoing was made, we, the aforementioned commander, caused our seal to be attached to this document as evidence. Given in the year and on the day stated above, in the second indiction.

Seals: (A) two seals, the first missing, the second badly damaged (illustration 94); (B) seal detached and missing.
